checkedAlternates.risk: Sun-Synchronous orbits are usually at LEO altitudes (~600–800 km).
checkedAlternates.resolution: SSO is a specialized near-polar retrograde orbit synchronized to local solar time (group-1), distinct from standard inclined LEO orbits (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Molniya orbit has a 12-hour period like GPS.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Molniya is a highly elliptical orbit reaching ~40,000 km apogee (group-4), unlike circular MEO navigation orbits (group-3).
